events.title: End of Taliban rule
events.description: The Taliban lost Kabul on 13–14 November 2001 and Kandahar, their last stronghold, by 9 December 2001. Their fighters withdrew to the south and east and across the border, and began an insurgency against the new government and the US-led coalition.

historical.review_note: Dates are sourced. The provinces are a province-level approximation on the game map (one game province can cover a whole governorate); check against the source's territorial-control maps.

events.title: Afghan Interim Administration
events.description: The Afghan Interim Administration under Hamid Karzai took office on 22 December 2001, and the United Front's Islamic State of Afghanistan handed over power to it.

events.title: Islamic Republic of Afghanistan
events.description: Hamid Karzai took office as President on 7 December 2004 under the 2004 Constitution, which made Afghanistan an Islamic republic with a presidential system.

events.title: Taliban offensive
events.description: On 1 May 2021, as foreign troops withdrew, the Taliban began an offensive that took most rural districts and then the provincial capitals.

events.title: Fall of Kabul
events.description: The Taliban entered Kabul on 15 August 2021. President Ashraf Ghani left the country, the government collapsed, and the Taliban restored the Islamic Emirate.

events.title: Invasion force in Kuwait
events.description: US ground forces crossed into Iraq from Kuwait when the invasion began on 20 March 2003 and advanced rapidly on Baghdad, while Iraqi forces collapsed. The number of divisions and the size of the Iraqi penalty are gameplay values.

events.title: British forces in Kuwait
events.description: British forces took part in the invasion from Kuwait from 20 March 2003, in the south around Basra. The number of divisions is a gameplay value.

events.title: Fall of Baghdad
events.description: US forces entered Baghdad in the battle of 3–9 April 2003; on 9 April the government lost control of the capital, and Iraqi forces collapsed across the country. Provinces not yet taken in play pass to coalition control.

events.title: Constitution of Iraq
events.description: Iraq's current constitution, establishing a federal parliamentary republic, was approved in a referendum on 15 October 2005.

events.title: End of the invasion of Iraq
events.description: Baghdad fell on 9 April 2003, and the invasion phase ended on 1 May 2003. Coalition forces stayed in Iraq under the Coalition Provisional Authority, which handed sovereignty to an Iraqi government on 28 June 2004.

events.title: First Battle of Fallujah
events.description: Insurgents held Fallujah against US Marines in the First Battle of Fallujah, 4 April – 1 May 2004, and kept control of the city until the Second Battle of Fallujah (7 November – 23 December 2004). Insurgents stayed strong in Anbar until 2006. The insurgency as a whole lasted from 9 April 2003 to 18 December 2011.
